name: No-El
author: Addicting Games
description: No-El is a free escape game. Oh no it's time for another holiday and it's up to you to save that holiday. If you aren't able to finish your holiday-themed mission then there will not be a holiday for all of the good boys and girls of the world who have earned gifts through their behavior and general affect for the previous year. Anyway, No-El is a puzzle game where you must activate a variety of buttons in order to generate an escape door. It is a puzzle platform game in which you are armed with the ability to push a giant present on top of a button and also fire green lasers. The lasers have the tendency to stick to depress vertically aligned buttons as well as sticking to walls, thus allowing you to use them as a make-shift ledge for jumping up and out of the pit you're in. This is a puzzlingly fun game that is more fun the more puzzley it gets. If you've ever dreamed of being an elf or shooting green lasers then this is absolutely the best game possible for you.
